into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview uses it, and so will the Site build,\nso the preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True}).enable(\"table\")\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out.\"\"\"\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls)\n\n\nclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n\n\n# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = [(quote, level,\n                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n            found.add(quote)\n            for i in range(*match.span()):\n                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n    out, offset = [], 0\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n            offset += len(piece)\n        else:\n            out.append(piece)\n    return \"\".join(out), found\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\n-- last_login_at was added in T09 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_login_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"users\", \"last_login_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()","is_error":false},{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018FYPMmiQT1K4mC7P9Guwu9","type":"tool_result","content":"## Working conventions\n\nAll conventions in A test can replace\n    `app.publish.deploy` again to make the push fail.\"\"\"\n    from app import publish, settings\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    pushed: list[Path] = []\n    monkeypatch.setattr(publish, \"deploy\", lambda out, *_: pushed.append(out))\n    return pushed\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account directly, in any state, with its setup done\n    (quicker than making it on the Users page, which T09's tests do).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    \"\"\"Submit the login form the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        if c.get(\"/login\").status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = login(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login","is_error":false}]}}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3","hash":"21ac62dde8569cdc9f22e37eda696eff93e59037a0901a84176f6296dc5edf1b","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_014xk3reR9c6Eb785NuhoNtV","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: T07 #8 Game Terms — seams: Seam 1 console over HTTP, Seam 2 render_site"}]}}

fi ;; esac; fi","durationMs":40},"type":"attachment","uuid":"cefc0999-7740-4a9d-830e-afed1a13315d","timestamp":"2026-10-18T01:31:26.129Z","session_id":"8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}
{"parentUuid":"fd22bcdb-3437-4638-bb8d-dba0d44f6140","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4f9dab00-8529-4cb3-8ad1-8cec52e42a2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GLBGhFUMcBBZEyyGvTZ9T6","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment()\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n52:CAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n53-    \"admin\": frozenset({\n54-        \"publish_guides\",      # Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment()\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3","hash":"def0272cc4c775bea59dee95664722dc3d7d0008d4deb10359b5fc7cb7bcba50","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GLBGhFUMcBBZEyyGvTZ9T6","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment()\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n52:CAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n53-    \"admin\": frozenset({\n54-        \"publish_guides\",      # {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3","hash":"0ecc73ee650181516a4a2d0cd38d362a57168b1534d5c12cde8bcf147c562f17","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017im2otCNmEUFWubmyoBFhL","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Guides in the console: the content list, the editor, and the workflow\nbuttons. Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom itertools import zip_longest\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields, ReviewNote, Revision\nfrom app.web import AdminRequired, flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        value = form.get(name)\n        return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=_id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide.id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_guide_form(request: Request,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\ndef preview_page(request: Request, user: User, item: Guide | Revision):\n    \"\"\"The Guide (or Revision) as Readers will see it, with the passages its\n    Review notes quote highlighted, the latest round's set apart from earlier\n    rounds' (here only: the Site build never highlights).\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        latest, earlier = guides.quotes_to_highlight(conn, user, item)\n    body_zh, found_zh = highlight(render_markdown(item.body_zh), latest, earlier)\n    body_en, found_en = highlight(render_markdown(item.body_en), latest, earlier)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_preview.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"预览：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": item, \"body_zh\": body_zh, \"body_en\": body_en,\n         \"quotes\": latest + earlier, \"earlier\": earlier,\n         \"found\": found_zh | found_en})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return preview_page(request, user, guide)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\nWorkflowStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int], Guide | Revision]\n\n\ndef workflow_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields | None, step: WorkflowStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a workflow button. When the editor form came along, its edits are\n    saved in the same transaction: if the step is refused they are not saved\n    either, and the editor shows them again with the reason.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n            step(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.submit,\n                         \"已提交审核，请等待管理员审核。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,\n                         \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")\n\n\nasync def sent_review_notes(request: Request) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The Review note builder's rows, in order. Rows left wholly blank are\n    dropped; a half-filled row is kept, for app/guides.py to refuse.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    def texts(name: str) -> list[str]:  # anything but text (a file) is blank\n        return [value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\" for value in form.getlist(name)]\n    rows = zip_longest(texts(\"quote\"), texts(\"advice\"), fillvalue=\"\")\n    return [ReviewNote(quote, advice) for quote, advice in rows\n            if quote.strip() or advice.strip()]\n\n\nBLANK_NOTE_ROWS = 3\n\n\ndef review_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | Revision,\n                notes: list[ReviewNote], *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    rows = notes + [ReviewNote(\"\", \"\")] * max(BLANK_NOTE_ROWS - len(notes), 1)\n    kind = \"修订\" if guide.is_revision else \"\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_review.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"审核{kind}：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"notes\": rows, \"error\": error,\n         \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh),\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/review\")\ndef review_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n{% extends \"site/base.html\" %}\n{% block title %}{{ guide|localized(\"title\", lang) }} · {{ t.site_name }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article>\n    <h1>{{ guide|localized(\"title\", lang) }}</h1>\n    <p>\n      <a href=\"{{ link(\"heroes/\" ~ guide.hero_slug ~ \"/\") }}\">{{ guide|localized(\"hero_name\", lang) }}</a>\n      · {{ guide.patch_name }}\n      · <a href=\"{{ link(\"authors/\" ~ guide.author_id ~ \"/\") }}\">{{ guide.author_name }}</a>\n      · {{ t.updated }} {{ guide.updated_at[:10] }}\n    </p>\n    {{ guide|localized(\"body\", lang)|markdown|safe }}\n  </article>\n{% endblock %}\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"{{ \"zh-CN\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"en\" }}\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ site_link(\"style.css\") }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header>\n    <a class=\"brand\" href=\"{{ link(\"\") }}\">{{ t.site_name }}</a>\n    {% if current_patch %}<span>{{ t.current_patch }}{{ current_patch }}</span>{% endif %}\n    <a class=\"language-switch\" href=\"{{ switch_link }}\" hreflang=\"{{ other }}\">{{ t.other_language }}</a>\n  </header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n</body>\n</html>\n\"\"\"T02: Admins manage Heroes and Patches (Seam 1: the console over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef add_hero(c: TestClient, name_zh: str, name_en: str):\n    return submit(c, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n                  name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n\n\ndef test_admin_adds_a_hero_and_sees_it_listed_with_its_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/heroes\"\n\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"瓦妮莎\" in page.text and \"Vanessa\" in page.text\n    assert \"vanessa\" in page.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name_zh, name_en, message\", [\n    (\"\", \"Vanessa\", \"请填写官方中文名\"),\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"   \", \"请填写官方英文名\"),\n])\ndef test_a_hero_missing_either_official_name_is_refused(client_as, name_zh,\n                                                        name_en, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, name_zh, name_en)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    assert \"还没有英雄\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_two_word_english_name_gives_a_hyphenated_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"黑骑士\", \"Black  Knight\")\n    assert \"<code>black-knight</code>\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_hero_whose_slug_is_already_taken_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"另一个瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa!\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"网址名 vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎（Vanessa）使用\" in response.text\n    assert \"另一个瓦妮莎\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_new_hero_with_another_heros_english_name_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"另一个瓦妮莎\", \"vanessa \")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"官方英文名 Vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎 使用\" in response.text\n    assert \"另一个瓦妮莎\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_english_names_clash_ignoring_non_ascii_case_too(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"埃克莱尔\", \"Éclair\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"杜利\", \"Dooley\")","is_error":false}]}}

with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n It is not a formal organization, but it is a clear group. Right now its home base is **Bilibili**: a few top streamers (**up主**) and their fans. The streamers do live streams and post videos. Fans watch the streams or videos and talk in the comment sections.\n\n## Who runs the site\n\nThe site would be run by those few top streamers. They are fairly well known and they already have experience managing fan groups. But they are not very comfortable with computers. They would be the **admins**.\n\nBesides them, there would be some invited guide writers: other up主 or experienced players. They would be **editors**. They can write guides, but they can't manage users.\n\nWriting in Markdown shouldn't be a big problem. Among all the up主 there will definitely be some who can do it, and even if none of them can, they can easily use AI to convert their text.\n\n## Who reads it, and what they want\n\nAnyone who plays the game. They just read; they don't need an account. The Bazaar has a strong guide culture. Compared with MOBAs or FPS games, a card game is more about strategy than mechanics, so players need guides more than in other games.\n\n## What is broken right now\n\nEverything is on Bilibili, and it is all video or live streams. A video is not like a written guide: you can't read it in a few spare minutes, or when you can't turn the sound on. Clear-cut information like **end-game builds** (终局阵容) is hard to find inside a video. Right now most streamers make guides by talking over a PowerPoint. A website with written guides (something like **旅法师营地**) would be a better channel for this. Comments and discussion can stay on Bilibili.\n\n...\n</persisted-output>","is_error":false}]}}
