It is not a formal organization, but it is a clear group. Right now its home base is **Bilibili**: a few top streamers (**up主**) and their fans. The streamers do live streams and post videos. Fans watch the streams or videos and talk in the comment sections.\n\n## Who runs the site\n\nThe site would be run by those few top streamers. They are fairly well known and they already have experience managing fan groups. But they are not very comfortable with computers. They would be the **admins**.\n\nBesides them, there would be some invited guide writers: other up主 or experienced players. They would be **editors**. They can write guides, but they can't manage users.\n\nWriting in Markdown shouldn't be a big problem. Among all the up主 there will definitely be some who can do it, and even if none of them can, they can easily use AI to convert their text.\n\n## Who reads it, and what they want\n\nAnyone who plays the game. They just read; they don't need an account. The Bazaar has a strong guide culture. Compared with MOBAs or FPS games, a card game is more about strategy than mechanics, so players need guides more than in other games.\n\n## What is broken right now\n\nEverything is on Bilibili, and it is all video or live streams. A video is not like a written guide: you can't read it in a few spare minutes, or when you can't turn the sound on. Clear-cut information like **end-game builds** (终局阵容) is hard to find inside a video. Right now most streamers make guides by talking over a PowerPoint. A website with written guides (something like **旅法师营地**) would be a better channel for this. Comments and discussion can stay on Bilibili.\n\nTiming is another big problem. The game gets **balance patches** that make cards stronger or weaker, on average about twice a month. Videos cost a lot to make (a single author might only post one or two a month), so they go out of date fast. When I look for a guide, unless it was just posted, it's hard to say how much it still applies.\n\n## What would make them say \"this is better\"\n\nThey don't have a website yet. The biggest advantage of a website is that the information is easy to get to.\n\nSay I want a guide for a specific hero on a specific patch. Right now I can only search Bilibili videos, and the videos are long, so it's hard to jump straight to the build I want. The Bazaar is a roguelike, so every run is different, and even inside one run the build keeps changing. That makes it really hard to get the information I need.\n\nThe existing guide videos are just someone talking over a PowerPoint. The useful information is only the pictures and what the up主 says. A post is clearly more direct: what they want to say can be written as text, and the pictures from the PowerPoint can go straight into the post. That is simpler for both the viewers and the people making guides.\n\nThe site would have three main pages in the menu: **Guides** (攻略), **Tournaments** (锦标赛), and **About** (关于). Guides can be browsed by **hero** or by **author**. Hero is the obvious one. I expect there won't be too many authors, so browsing by author works too.\n\n## What must not happen\n\nEditors and admins must have very different permissions. Admins should be able to control all users and all posts and pages. Editors should only be able to write guides. An editor must never be able to manage users or publish something that an admin hasn't reviewed: an editor's guide stays a draft until an admin checks it and publishes it.\n\nThis is not the final design yet, so this is what I have for now.\n# Field notes — WordPress Playground, 2026-10-15\n\n1. When I was writing new posts, the advanced settings had a box called additional CSS. I tried to type some words there, but it only accept specific format input, such as “color: red”\n\n2. the admin account can both edit and quick edit each post. I don’t quite understand why the quick edit function is necessary, is it for the convenience of the admin?\n\n3. There are some preset color schemes with their names. Each theme has four colors, but I did not find what the fourth color controls.\n\n4. I made a comment with a subscriber account and it did not appear until I approved it using the admin account. Then I noticed that there were two options — one is that every comments need approval, and the other is that once an user have previously approved comments, their future comments will not need approval to appear. Generally, the admin account has a lot of features and it is kind of difficult to quickly locate the wanted feature every time.\n\n5. I did not expect that I can set my own link for the webpage. It looks like as long as the front part is the web address, and after the “/”, the rest part can be anything.\n\n6. There is a box that the admin account can put some words to ban them from comments. It is just one text box, so I am not sure if I want to put several different word or phrases in it, how I could separate them .\n\n7. There is a shop option near the bottom, but it does not redirect to anywhere when clicking. When last time I navigate, I remember that I can adjust this function at the setting part, such as make custom coupons, but this time it disappear.\n\n8. The draft does not show up on public site. It only appears after publishing.\n\n9. Only admin account has the users menu and editor does not. I also tried typing the URL directly as the editor, but that also does not work.\n\n10. I created several accounts and saved the username and password in chrome. Google immediately told me that they had been leaked.\n\n11. Playground drops you straight into the admin dashboard as \"Howdy, admin\" — no login screen, no password. You're just already an admin with full edit rights over the whole site. That's the opposite of what MP2 wants: my CMS has to make you actually authenticate before you can touch anything.\n\n12. I poked around the checkout/coupon area (this is a WooCommerce demo, not core WordPress, so not directly one of my 7 capabilities) and found a real bug: I applied a coupon at checkout and it said \"applied\" successfully, but the price didn't actually go down. The discount logic and the UI confirmation aren't actually wired together — the interface lied about what happened. {"parentUuid":"503dd857-a4d8-400d-aad5-c10925a2a75c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4f9dab00-8529-4cb3-8ad1-8cec52e42a2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FtwfJkRBfVFxb4xdvbajEV","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\nits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\nGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\nGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\ndirectly.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\nDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\nTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\nfrom typing import ClassVar\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import SUBMISSION_BANNED, User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    trashed_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n    revision_status: str | None  # the open Revision's status, if there is one\n    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = False\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Where the Guide's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n        return f\"admin/guides/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide | Revision) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id\n           AND review_rounds.revision_id IS NULL)) AS returned,\n       (SELECT status FROM revisions WHERE revisions.guide_id = guides.id)\n         AS revision_status\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\n_NOT_TRASHED = \"guides.trashed_at IS NULL\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Guide)}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\"\"\"T04: the Site build puts Published Guides online in Chinese and English.\n\nContent is set up through the console (Seam 1); what Readers get is checked in\nthe files `render_site` writes (Seam 2).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport posixpath\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import publish, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\nfrom test_t03_guides import (act, admin, editor, hero_id, new_guide,  # noqa: F401\n                             patch_id, save, slug_of)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef site(tmp_path) -> Path:\n    return tmp_path / \"site\"\n\n\ndef published_guide(admin: TestClient, editor: TestClient | None = None,\n                    **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Guide written by `editor` (or the Admin), Submitted and Published.\n    Returns its slug.\"\"\"\n    author = editor or admin\n    edit_page = new_guide(author, **fields)\n    if editor:\n        assert act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    assert act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return slug_of(admin, edit_page)\n\n\ndef page(site: Path, path: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text of the page Readers get at `path` (a folder such as\n    `zh/guides/vanessa-1/`).\"\"\"\n    file = site / path / \"index.html\"\n    assert file.exists(), f\"no page at {path}\"\n    return file.read_text()\n\n\ndef test_a_published_guide_gets_its_own_page(admin, site):\n    slug = published_guide(admin, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                           body_zh=\"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\")\n    html = page(render_site(site), f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\")\n    assert \"瓦妮莎海盗流\" in html\n    assert \"<h2>终局阵容</h2>\" in html\n\n\ndef site_text(site: Path) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Every generated HTML file, run together.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(file.read_text() for file in sorted(site.rglob(\"*.html\")))\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_submitted_guides_never_appear_anywhere(admin, editor, site):\n\"\"\"#18: console pages link with relative paths only, and every link still\nreaches its page from whatever URL depth the page is served at.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom starlette.requests import Request\n\nfrom app import web\nfrom conftest import login\nfrom test_t01_login import new_editor_needing_setup\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import add_hero, add_patch, edit_link, submit\nfrom test_t03_guides import new_guide\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nGET_FORM = re.compile(r'<form method=\"get\" action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return LINK.findall(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"root_path\", [\"\", \"/cms\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, prefix\", [\n    (\"/\", \"\"),\n    (\"/login\", \"\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides\", \"../\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides/5/edit\", \"../../../\"),\n])\ndef test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):\n    # Starlette puts a mount prefix (root_path) in front of the path itself.\n    full = root_path + path\n    request = Request({\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"path\": full,\n                       \"root_path\": root_path, \"headers\": [], \"query_string\": b\"\"})\n    assert web.console_root(request) == prefix\n    assert urljoin(f\"http://testserver{full}\", f\"{prefix}login\") \\\n        == f\"http://testserver{root_path}/login\"\n\n\ndef check_page(c: TestClient, page_url: str, page: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"No root-absolute path on the page, and each link, resolved against the\n    page's own URL, reaches a console route that answers it.\"\"\"\n    found = links(page)\n    assert found, f\"{page_url} has no links\"\n    get_forms = GET_FORM.findall(page)\n    for attribute, target in found:\n        assert not target.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_url}: {attribute}={target!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{page_url}\", target)\n        if attribute == \"href\" or (attribute == \"action\" and target in get_forms):\n            assert c.get(resolved).status_code == 200, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n        else:\n            # POST targets: an empty form is refused for its CSRF token (403),\n            # which only happens on a route that exists and accepts POST.\n            response = c.post(resolved, follow_redirects=False)\n            assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import add_user, csrf_token, login\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the <option> showing `label` on a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<option value=\"(\\d+)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(label)}</option>', page)\n    assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef choice(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the Hero or Patch picker option showing `label`.\"\"\"\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\nhero_id = patch_id = choice\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = fill_in(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef form_values(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form on `page` would send unchanged: its text inputs,\n    textareas and selected options.\"\"\"\n    values = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page))\n    values |= dict(re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page,\n                              re.DOTALL))\n    for name, options in re.findall(r'<select name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page,\n                                    re.DOTALL):\n        selected = re.search(r'<option value=\"(\\d*)\" selected', options)\n        values[name] = selected.group(1) if selected else \"\"\n    return {name: html.unescape(value) for name, value in values.items()}\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Change some fields of a saved Guide, keeping the rest as they are.\"\"\"\n    current = form_values(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    return fill_in(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **(current | fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the <option> showing `label` on a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<option value=\"(\\d+)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(label)}</option>', page)\n    assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef choice(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the Hero or Patch picker option showing `label`.\"\"\"\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\nhero_id = patch_id = choice\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = fill_in(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef form_values(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form on `page` would send unchanged: its text inputs,\n    textareas and selected options.\"\"\"\n    values = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page))\n    values |= dict(re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page,\n                              re.DOTALL))\n    for name, options in re.findall(r'<select name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page,\n                                    re.DOTALL):\n        selected = re.search(r'<option value=\"(\\d*)\" selected', options)\n        values[name] = selected.group(1) if selected else \"\"\n    return {name: html.unescape(value) for name, value in values.items()}\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Change some fields of a saved Guide, keeping the rest as they are.\"\"\"\n    current = form_values(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    return fill_in(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **(current | fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base template, whose stylesheet\n    # and home links only exist on the Site; its link into the console works.\n    hello = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert not [t for _, t in links(hello) if t.startswith(\"/\")]\n    assert (\"href\", \"login\") in links(hello)\n\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", client.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n\n\ndef test_revision_and_trash_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(\n        admin, client_as):\n    from test_t03_guides import act\n    from test_t06_revisions_trash import delete, open_revision, revision_page\n\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    edit_page = revision, \"submit\")\n    guide = edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    for c, page_url in [(editor, revision), (editor, f\"{guide}/revision/preview\"),\n                        (editor, f\"{guide}/delete\"),\n                        (editor, f\"{guide}/revision/delete\"), (admin, revision),\n                        (admin, f\"{guide}/revision/review\")]:\n        response = test_users_pages_and_the_refusal_page_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(\n        admin, client_as):\n    from test_t09_users import EDITOR, account_page, create_account\n\n    create_account(admin, \"writer@example.test\")\n    editor_page = account_page(admin, EDITOR)\n    for page_url in [\"/admin/users\", editor_page, f\"{editor_page}/deactivate\",\n account 1 is the Admin\n    dashboard = editor.get(\"/admin/dashboard\").text\n    assert 'admin/users\"' not in dashboard\n    # A real token and real fields, so the refusal is about the role alone.\n    data = {\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(dashboard), \"role\": \"editor\",\n            \"email\": \"sneaky@example.test\", \"temporary_password\": \"sneaky-pw-1\"}\n    response = editor.request(method, path, data=data if method == \"POST\" else None,\n                              follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"只有管理员\" in response.text\n    assert \"退出登录\" in response.text  # a console page, not a dead end\n\n    admin_row = user_row(admin, ADMIN)\n    assert \"管理员\" in admin_row and \"正常\" in admin_row\n    assert \"待首次登录设置\" not in admin_row\n    assert \"sneaky@example.test\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path\", admin_only_routes())\ndef test_a_signed_out_visitor_is_sent_to_login_on_every_admin_only_route(\n    return rounds\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        item: Guide | Revision) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again. A Revision has rounds of its own; a Guide's leave out those of its\n    past Revisions, which quoted the Revision's text.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(item, Revision):\n        rounds = revision_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n    elif item.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n    else:\n        rounds = [round for round in review_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n                  if not round.of_revision]\n    if not rounds:\n        return [], []\n    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n        if quote not in latest]\n    return latest, earlier\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(guide: Guide | Revision,\n                   notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh), quotes)[1]\n             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en), quotes)[1])\n    for quote in quotes:\n        if quote not in found:\n            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash, users\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    app.include_router(trash.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp =       files={\"file\": (\"terms.csv\", text.encode(encoding), \"text/csv\")},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef confirm_import(c: TestClient, preview: str):\n    \"\"\"Press 确认导入 on name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"',\n                             form[:form.index(\"</form>\")]))\n    return c.post(\"/admin/terms/import/confirm\",\n                  data={name: html.unescape(value) for name, value in fields.items()},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_a_csv_import_shows_what_it_will_add_and_change_before_saving(admin):\n    add_term(admin, \"item\", \"海盗弯刀\", \"Pirate Scimitar\", nicknames=\"弯刀\")\n    preview = upload_csv(admin, CSV_HEADER\n                         + \"英雄,朱尔斯,Jules,\\n\"\n                         + \"<td>英雄</td><td>朱尔斯</td><td>Jules</td>\" in preview.text\n    assert \"<td>技能</td><td>快速装填</td><td>Quick Reload</td><td>快装、速装</td>\" in preview.text\n    assert \"将修改 1 个\" in preview.text\n    assert \"海盗弯刀（Pirate Scimitar）→ 新海盗弯刀（pirate scimitar）\" in preview.text\n\n    terms = admin.get(\"/admin/terms\").text\n    assert \"快速装填\" not in terms and \"新海盗弯刀\" not in terms\n    assert \"朱尔斯\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_confirming_a_csv_import_saves_the_previewed_rows(admin):\n    add_term(admin, \"item\", \"海盗弯刀\", \"Pirate Scimitar\", nicknames=\"弯刀\")\n    preview = upload_csv(admin, CSV_HEADER\n                         + \"英雄,朱尔斯,Jules,\\n\"\n                         + \"item,新海盗弯刀,Pirate Scimitar,\\n\"\n Bad rows are rejected one by one, so the good ones can still\n# be imported.\n\nCSV_COLUMNS = (\"kind\", \"name_zh\", \"name_en\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass CsvRow:\n    number: int  # the row number a spreadsheet shows, the header being row 1\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImportPlan:\n    added: list[CsvRow]\n    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]]  # the term as it is, and its row\n    unchanged: int\n    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]]  # (row number, reason)\n\n\ndef _kind_of(written: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The kind a CSV cell names, by its English key or its Chinese name.\"\"\"\n    written = written.strip()\n    return next((kind for kind, label in KINDS.items()\n                 if written.casefold() == kind or written == label), None)\n\n\ndef _csv_rows(csv_bytes: bytes) -> Iterator[tuple[int, dict[str, str]]]:\n    \"\"\"The file's rows after the header, numbered, with their cells trimmed;\n    wholly blank rows are skipped. Raises Refused if the file isn't UTF-8 or\n    lacks the header.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        text = csv_bytes.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")  # Excel starts its UTF-8 with a BOM\n    except UnicodeDecodeError:\n        raise Refused(\"读不出这个文件。请把 CSV 存成 UTF-8 编码后再上传。\") from None\n    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))\n    header = [cell.strip().lower() for cell in next(reader, [])]\n    if not set(CSV_COLUMNS) <= set(header):\n        raise Refused(\"CSV 第一行必须是表头：kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames\"\n                      \"（nicknames 一列可以省略）。\")\n    for number, cells in enumerate(reader, start=2):\n        row = {column: cell.strip() for column, cell in zip(header, cells)}\n        if any(row.values()):\n            yield number, row\n\n\ndef plan_import(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"What importing the CSV file would add and change, and the rows it\n    would reject with the reason for each. Nothing is saved. An empty\n    nicknames cell keeps the nicknames a term already has.\"\"\"\n    existing = {(term.kind, term.name_en.casefold()): term\n                for term in glossary(conn).terms}\n    plan = ImportPlan(added=[], changed=[], unchanged=0, rejected=[])\n    rows_by_term: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}\n    new_slugs: dict[str, int] = {}\n    unchanged = 0\n    for number, cells in _csv_rows(csv_bytes):\n        kind = _kind_of(cells.get(\"kind\", \"\"))\n        if kind is None:\n            plan.rejected.append((number, f\"未知的种类“{cells.get('kind', '')}”。种类须是\"\n                                  f\"{'、'.join(KINDS.values())}之一，或其英文\"\n                                  f\"（{', '.join(KINDS)}）。\"))\n            continue\n        try:\n            name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(cells.get(\"name_zh\", \"\"),\n                                              cells.get(\"name_en\", \"\"))\n        except Refused as refused:\n            plan.rejected.append((number, refused.message.replace(\"请填写\", \"缺少\")))\n            continue\n        key = (kind, name_en.casefold())\n        if key in rows_by_term:\n            plan.rejected.append((number, f\"和第 {rows_by_term[key]} 行是同一个游戏术语\"\n                                  \"（种类和官方英文名都相同）。\"))\n            continue\n        rows_by_term[key] = number\n        row = CsvRow(number, kind, name_zh, name_en,\n                     parse_nicknames(cells.get(\"nicknames\", \"\")))\n        term = existing.get(key)\n        if term is None and kind == \"hero\":\n            try:\n                slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)[2]\n            except Refused as refused:\n                plan.rejected.append((number, refused.message))\n                continue\n            if slug in new_slugs:\n                plan.rejected.append((number, f\"网址名 {slug} 已被第 {new_slugs[slug]}\"\n                                      \" 行的英雄使用。\"))\n                continue\n            new_slugs[slug] = number\n        if term is None:\n            plan.added.append(row)\n        elif (term.name_zh, term.name_en) != (name_zh, name_en) or (\n                row.nicknames and row.nicknames != term.nicknames):\n            plan.changed.append((term, row))\n        else:\n            unchanged += 1\n    return ImportPlan(plan.added, plan.changed, unchanged, plan.rejected)\n\n\ndef import_terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"Import the CSV file's good rows, as plan_import plans, and say what\n    was done.\"\"\"\n    plan = plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n    for row in plan.added:\n        add = add_hero if row.kind == \"hero\" else partial(add_term, kind=row.kind)\n        add(conn, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n            nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames))\n    for term, row in plan.changed:\n        edit_term(conn, term.id, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n                  nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames or term.nicknames))\n    return plan\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"app/game.py\")\ns = p.read_text()\ns = s.replace('''import user is not None, f\"{email} should have been created above\"\n    return user\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n            try:\n                accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                     role=role, display_name=display_name)\n            except accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n        for name_zh, name_en in DEMO_HEROES:\n            try:\n                game.add_hero(conn, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"hero: {name_en} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"hero: created {name_zh} ({name_en}).\")\n        for name in DEMO_PATCHES:\n            try:\n                game.add_patch(conn, name)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"patch: {name} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"patch: created {name}.\")\n        seed_guides(conn)\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n\"\"\"T02: the seed script adds demo Heroes and Patches (Seam 2: the seed script,\nchecked through the console).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, login\nfrom test_t01_seed import run_seed\n\nENV = {\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-admin\",\n       \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-editor\"}\n\n\ndef seeded_admin(tmp_path, monkeypatch, times: int = 1) -> TestClient:\n    seeded_db = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    for _ in range(times):\n        result = run_seed({\"CMS_DATABASE\": str(seeded_db), **ENV})\n        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(seeded_db))\n    admin = TestClient(create_app())\n    login(admin, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"from-env-admin\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_seed_creates_demo_heroes_and_patches_with_the_newest_current(\n        tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    admin = seeded_admin(tmp_path, monkeypatch)\n\n    heroes = admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n    assert \"<td>瓦妮莎</td><td>Vanessa</td><td><code>vanessa</code></td>\" in heroes\n    assert heroes.count(\"/edit\\\"\") >= 3\n    patches = admin.get(\"/admin/patches\").text\n    assert \"<td>6.7（当前版本）</td>\" in patches\n    assert \"<td>6.6</td>\" in patches and \"<td>6.5</td>\" in patches\n\n\ndef test_seeding_twice_adds_no_duplicate_heroes_or_patches(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    admin = seeded_admin(tmp_path, monkeypatch, times=2)\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text.count(\"<td>Vanessa</td>\") == 1\n    patches = admin.get(\"/admin/patches\").text\n    assert patches.count(\"<td>6.5\") == 1\n    assert \"<td>6.7（当前版本）</td>\" in patches","is_error":false}]}}

The passwords come from\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD; there are no default passwords, so\nthe script refuses to run without both. Running it again leaves existing\naccounts, Heroes and Patches alone, and adds no Guides once any exist.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed. Later tickets add\nother Game Terms, a Page and Tournament items.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, game, guides, settings\n\n# Matches DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py (which uses its own fixed passwords).\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    # role, email, Display name, environment variable holding the password\n    (\"admin\", \"admin@example.test\", \"演示管理员\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"editor@example.test\", \"演示编辑\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n# Official Chinese name, official English name.\nDEMO_HEROES = [\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"),\n    (\"皮格马利翁\", \"Pygmalien\"),\n    (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\"),\n    (\"马克\", \"Mak\"),\n]\n# Oldest first, so the last one added is the Current Patch.\nDEMO_PATCHES = [\"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]\n\n# Author's role, Hero (English name), Patch, status reached, Chinese title,\n# Chinese body, English title, English body.\nDEMO_GUIDES = [\n    (\"editor\", \"Vanessa\", \"6.7\", \"draft\", \"瓦妮莎海盗船流（写作中）\",\n     \"## 思路\\n\\n先拿船，再找炮。终局阵容还在测试。\", \"\", \"\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"Dooley\", \"6.7\", \"submitted\", \"杜利核心流入门\",\n     \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n围绕核心，前期拿**能量**物品。\\n\\n## 运营\\n\\n第 5 天前定型。\",\n     \"Dooley core build for beginners\",\n     \"## Final lineup\\n\\nBuild around the core and take **energy** items early.\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"Pygmalien\", \"6.6\", \"published\", \"皮格马利翁经济流\",\n     \"## 思路\\n\\n前期攒钱，中期一次性升级。\", \"\", \"\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"Mak\", \"6.7\", \"published\", \"马克药水流（6.7）\",\n     \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n药水叠毒，配合治疗。\\n\\n| 天数 | 目标 |\\n|---|---|\\n| 1–4 | 拿药水 |\\n| 5+ | 叠毒 |\",\n     \"Mak potion build (6.7)\",\n     \"## Final lineup\\n\\nStack poison with potions and heal through the midgame.\"),\n]\n\n\ndef seed_guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    admin = _seed_user(conn, \"admin\")\n    if guides.guides(conn, admin):\n        print(\"guides: some already exist, none added.\")\n        return\n    heroes = {hero.name_en: hero.id for hero in game.heroes(conn)}\n    patches = {patch.name: patch.id for patch in game.patches(conn)}\n    for (role, hero, patch, status, title_zh, body_zh,\n         title_en, body_en) in DEMO_GUIDES:\n        author = _seed_user(conn, role)\n        guide = guides.create(conn, author, guides.GuideFields(\n            title_zh=title_zh, body_zh=body_zh, title_en=title_en,\n            body_en=body_en, hero_id=heroes[hero], patch_id=patches[patch]))\n        if status != \"draft\" and guides.can_submit(author, guide):\n            guides.submit(conn, author, guide.id)\n        if status == \"published\":\n            guides.publish(conn, admin, guide.id)\n        print(f\"guide: created {title_zh} {"parentUuid":"fe589fe8-55d7-41ff-b47c-02fc8186b8a3","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4f9dab00-8529-4cb3-8ad1-8cec52e42a2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01B5L82WNVhhJFrw98jz92sj","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/CONTEXT.md has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"642285e2-90eb-46de-affa-db5705359489","timestamp":"2026-10-18T01:49:16.796Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/CONTEXT.md","oldString":"_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n","newString":"_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Nickname** (外号):\nA name players use for a Game Term that the game itself doesn't, such as 瓦姐\nfor 瓦妮莎. Admins record them so the preview can warn a writer who uses one\nwithout a Game Term marker. The site never shows a nickname in place of an\nOfficial name.\n_Avoid_: alias, abbreviation, slang\n\n**Game Term marker** (术语标记):\n`[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]` in a Guide's text: a Game Term named by either\nOfficial name, shown on the site as its Official name in the Reader's\nlanguage. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text without the\nbrackets, and the preview warns about it.\n_Avoid_: tag, link, shortcode\n","originalFile":"# The Bazaar Guide Site (大巴扎攻略站)\n\nA small CMS where streamers (up主) and invited writers in the Chinese-speaking\ncommunity of the card game The Bazaar publish written guides, so players can\nfind a build for a given hero and patch without scrubbing through videos.\n\n## Language\n\n### People\n\n**Admin** (管理员):\nOne of the few top streamers who run the site. Reviews and publishes other\npeople's Guides and manages users.\n_Avoid_: owner, superuser\n\n**Editor** (编辑):\nAn invited guide writer (another up主 or an experienced player). Writes\nGuides but cannot publish them or manage users.\n_Avoid_: author (as a role name), contributor, writer\n\n**Reader** (读者):\nAnyone who plays the game and reads the public site. Has no account.\n_Avoid_: user, visitor, member\n\n**Author** (作者):\nThe Admin or Editor who wrote a Guide. Readers can browse all of an Author's\nPublished Guides on that Author's page.\n_Avoid_: owner, creator, up主 (not every Author is a streamer)\n\n**Submission ban** (禁止投稿):\nAn account state in which an Editor can still log in and work on Drafts but\ncannot Submit Guides or Revisions. Their Published Guides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: suspension, block, mute\n\n**Deactivated** (已停用):\nAn account state in which the person cannot log in at all. Their Published\nGuides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: deleted, disabled, banned\n\n**First-login setup** (首次登录设置):\nThe step a person with a temporary password must finish before using the\nconsole: they choose their own password and their Display name.\n_Avoid_: onboarding, activation, registration\n\n**Display name** (昵称):\nThe name an Author chooses to be shown under publicly. It is never their\nlogin username.\n_Avoid_: username, handle\n\n### Content\n\n**Guide** (攻略):\nA written strategy piece about one Hero on one Patch, typically built around\nscreenshots of a lineup or deck with an explanation of how it plays. Guides\nfor tournament mode are still Guides.\n_Avoid_: article, tutorial, post\n\n**Page** (页面):\nA standalone piece of site content written by an Admin, such as About (关于),\nthat appears in the public navigation.\n_Avoid_: static page\n\n**Tournament announcement** (锦标赛预告):\nAn Admin-written notice about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n_Avoid_: event, news, post\n\n**Tournament recap** (锦标赛回顾):\nAn Admin-written account of a Tournament that has already happened. It is a\nseparate item from that Tournament's announcement.\n_Avoid_: event, report, result\n\n**Chinese text / English text** (中文版 / 英文版):\nThe two language versions of a Guide (or other content), each with its own\ntitle and body. Chinese is required. English is optional, and content without\nit does not appear on the English site.\n_Avoid_: translation, localization, body\n\n### The game\n\n**Game Term** (游戏术语):\nA named thing in The Bazaar that has an official Chinese name and an official\nEnglish name, stored as a pair. It is one of seven kinds: Hero, Item, Skill,\nEnchantment, Monster, Merchant, or Event.\n_Avoid_: keyword, tag, entity\n\n**Item** (物品):\nThe Game Term kind for the cards a player builds with.\n_Avoid_: card\n\n**Event** (事件):\nThe Game Term kind for an in-game event a player encounters during a run. The\nword means only this; it is never used for a Tournament.\n_Avoid_: using \"event\" for Tournaments or site activity\n\n**Hero** (英雄):\nThe Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\nNo two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case).\n_Avoid_: character, class\n\n**Official name** (官方名称):\nThe name the game itself uses for a Game Term in a given language. The site\nonly ever shows Official names.\n_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Slug** (网址名):\nThe short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays\nthe same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide\nis created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a\nRevision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two\nHeroes, and no two Guides, share one.\n_Avoid_: URL name, permalink, handle\n\n**Patch** (版本):\nThe game version a Guide was written for, such as `6.7`. Picked by the\nwriter. It describes when the Guide was written and is not a verdict on\nwhether the Guide is out of date.\n_Avoid_: version (also used for edits to a Guide), season\n\n**Current Patch** (当前版本):\nThe Patch an Admin added most recently. Adding a Patch always makes it the\nCurrent Patch, even if its number is lower than an earlier one's.\n_Avoid_: latest version, live patch\n\n**Tournament** (锦标赛):\nAn experimental in-game mode in which many players (up to about 100) play one\ngame together until there is one champion. It is run by the game, not\norganized by players. It has its own section on the site.\n_Avoid_: event, competition, league, match\n\n### Workflow\n\n**Draft** (草稿):\nA Guide its writer has not finished yet. Only its writer and Admins can see it.\n_Avoid_: unpublished\n\n**Submitted** (待审核):\nA Guide its writer has marked finished, waiting for an Admin to review it.\n_Avoid_: pending, draft, ready\n\n**Return** (退回):\nAn Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide or Revision is not ready. It goes\nback to its writer as a Draft, with the Admin's notes. A Returned Revision\nleaves the Published Guide as it is.\n_Avoid_: reject, decline\n\n**Review note** (审核意见):\nPart of a Return: a passage quoted from the Guide together with the Admin's\nadvice on how to fix it.\n_Avoid_: comment (comments stay on Bilibili), feedback\n\n**Publish** (发布):\nAn Admin's approval of a Submitted Guide, which makes it Published. Publishing\ndoes not by itself change the public site.\n_Avoid_: approve, go live\n\n**Unpublish** (撤下):\nAn Admin taking a Published Guide off the site without deleting it. The Guide\ngoes back to its Author as a Draft, optionally with Review notes.\n_Avoid_: hide, archive, take offline\n\n**Published** (已发布):\nA Guide an Admin has approved. It will appear on the public site after the\nnext Site build.\n_Avoid_: live, approved\n\n**Trash** (回收站):\nWhere deleted Guides go. Only Admins can see it, and they can restore a Guide\nfrom it or delete it for good. A Guide in the Trash is never on the site.\n_Avoid_: archive, recycle bin, deleted\n\n**Revision** (修订):\nA proposed change to a Published Guide. While it waits for review the\nPublished Guide stays on the site unchanged. Once published, it replaces the\nold content and the old content is not shown.\n_Avoid_: version, new version, edit\n\n**Site build** (更新网站):\nRegenerating the public site from everything that is Published, and putting it\nonline. This is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n_Avoid_: publish, deploy, export\n\n## Flagged ambiguities\n\n- \"Draft\" was being used for both an unfinished Guide and a finished one\n  awaiting review. Those are now **Draft** and **Submitted**.\n- \"Version\" can mean the game's Patch or an edit to a Guide. Use **Patch** for\n  the game and **Revision** for an edit.\n- \"Publish\" meant both an Admin's approval and regenerating the site. Approval\n  is **Publish**; regenerating is **Site build**. An Editor never publishes:\n  their button is Submit (提交审核).\n- \"Event\" is a Game Term kind (事件). Tournament items are announcements and\n  recaps, never \"events\".\n- \"Card\" and \"Item\" are the same thing.
