{"parentUuid":"4a1caeaf-754e-4a35-849b-5fe12032a660","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f7e5d258-ecc3-4f1f-964e-46384eaa4e9a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0151iRhUHjxw4FMh2JBbMxEE","type":"tool_result","content":"T09: Admins manage users\n\nThe Users page (用户) lists every account with its Display name, email,\nrole, state, Guide counts (outside the Trash) and last login. Each\naccount's page lets an Admin change its role, apply or lift a Submission\nban, reset its password to a temporary one, and deactivate or reactivate\nit. New accounts start with a temporary password and first-login setup.\n\n- Lockout guards: an Admin can't demote, deactivate or reset themselves,\n  and the last active Admin is kept by the UPDATE itself, so two Admins\n  removing each other at once can't both succeed.\n- Every state change repeats its precondition in its UPDATE, so a change\n  another Admin made in between is never overwritten.\n- A Submission ban also blocks opening a Revision, and a banned Editor\n  sees the reason on every console page.\n- web.requires(capability) builds every Admin-only guard; a test walks\n  the routers and checks that Editors get 403 and signed-out visitors are\n  sent to login on every guarded route (21 today).\n- Editors refused on an Admin page get a console page (403) that keeps\n  the navigation.\n- users.last_login_at is added the additive way (ADDED_COLUMNS).\n\nCloses #10\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n\n## `/code-review` findings for T09, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review covered the uncommitted T09 work: the Users page, the account page, the lockout guards and the console 403 page.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `can_open_revision` (and `can_submit`) still offer the 修订 / 提交审核 buttons to a banned Editor, who is then refused. | **Kept the buttons, as designed:** story 76 wants a banned Editor told *why*, not left with a button that silently went missing. The refusal re-renders the editor with the reason. **Changed:** the reason now also appears up front, on every console page a banned Editor opens (`accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED`, shown from `base.html`), so they see it before clicking. Test: `test_a_banned_editor_keeps_drafting_but_submit_and_revisions_are_refused_with_the_reason`. |\n| 2 | `ban_submissions`, `lift_submission_ban` and `reactivate` read the state with one query, then UPDATE without re-checking it, so a change another Admin makes in between (e.g. a Deactivation) could be overwritten. | **Fixed.** Each UPDATE repeats its precondition in the WHERE clause (`AND state = …`, `AND role = 'editor'`), and refuses when no row changes (`CHANGED_MEANWHILE`). Promotion to Admin does the same against a concurrent ban. This matches how the last-Admin guard already worked. |\n| 3 | The Users page needs `manage_users`, but calls `guides.counts_by_author`, which checked `manage_all_guides` and raised a `guides.NotAllowed` nothing caught. | **Fixed.** `counts_by_author` exists only for the Users page, so it now checks `manage_users`. |\n| 4 | `user_manager` was a fourth copy of the \"signed in + capability, else `AdminRequired`\" guard. | **Fixed.** `web.requires(capability)` builds every guard: `admin_user`, `trash_manager`, `site_builder` and `user_manager`. Each guard it makes is recorded in `web.ADMIN_GUARDS`. The access-control test now finds guarded routes through that set rather than a list of function names, so a route behind any future guard is covered automatically (21 routes today). |\n| 5 | `accounts.NotAllowed` and `routes/users.status_for` duplicate `guides.NotAllowed` and `routes/guides.status_for`. | **Not changed in T09.** Merging the two `Refused` hierarchies touches every Guide route, which is a refactor of its own. The concrete gap the review pointed to (a `guides.NotAllowed` escaping a Users route) is gone with #3. |\n| 6 | `status_for` had a dead `AccountNotFound` branch, and the lookup-then-404 code was repeated three times. | **Fixed.** One `shown_account()` helper does the lookup and the 404; the dead branch is removed. |\n| 7 | The account page counts every Author's Guides to read one Author's counts. | **Not changed.** The site has a handful of Authors, so this is one small GROUP BY per page view. If it ever matters, it is a one-line change. |\n| 8 | Every account mutator re-read and returned the account, and the only caller threw it away. | **Fixed.** The mutators return `None`. |\n| 9 | `GET /admin/users/{id}/deactivate` showed \"are you sure?\" even for yourself or an account already Deactivated, and posting it was then refused. | **Fixed.** `accounts.check_deactivatable` refuses before the confirmation, and the account page is shown with the reason (400). Test: `test_an_admin_cannot_deactivate_themselves`. |\n| 10 | Templates hard-coded `minlength=\"8\"` and \"至少 8 个字符\". | **Fixed.** `min_password_length` is a template global from `accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH`, used on the Users page, the account page and first-login setup. |\n\nThe review also confirmed these hold:\n- the removed T01 deactivation test is covered by T09's test through the real Users page;\n- nothing calls the removed `set_state` any more;\n- every new form carries the CSRF token, and every new link is relative;\n- no password is logged or flashed;\n- `users.last_login_at` is in `ADDED_COLUMNS`.\n\n## Decisions not spelled out in the spec\n\n- **Temporary passwords are typed by the Admin** (at least 8 characters), when creating an account and when resetting a password. The server never shows or stores one in plain text.\n- **A password reset** also ends the user's open sessions. An Admin can't reset their own password. First-login setup then offers the user's current Display name, so a reset doesn't force a new one.\n- **A Submission ban is for Editors only**, since Admins Publish without Submitting. To promote a banned Editor, the ban must be lifted first.\n- **A banned Editor can't open a Revision** either, because they could never Submit it. Before T09, only Submit checked the ban.\n- **Reactivating an account returns it to the normal state.** A ban from before the deactivation is not kept, and the confirmation page says so.\n- **The last-active-Admin guard is part of the database update itself.** No console request can reach it: an Admin able to act is active, so the target is never the last Admin. It protects against two Admins removing each other at the same moment. It is tested in two ways:\n  - through HTTP: once A deactivates B, B's session is dead, so B can't deactivate A;\n  - with one direct call into `app/accounts.py` using a stale Admin, which is the only way to reach the guard. The user agreed to this exception to Seam 1.\n- **Editors refused on Admin routes** now get a console page (403) that keeps the navigation and logout, not plain text.\n- **Users page Guide counts** show \"已发布 N · 共 M\", where M counts Guides in every status outside the Trash.\n- **Last-login times are UTC**, like every other console timestamp.\n- **Schema:** `users.last_login_at` was added the additive way. A test with the pre-T09 users table checks it, and fails if the migration line is removed.\n\nVerification: `uv run pytest -q` gives 263 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"66577a56-330a-4c33-a8e4-c99d4174dad8","timestamp":"2026-10-18T01:57:16.699Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"T09: Admins manage users\n\nThe Users page (用户) lists every account with its Display name, email,\nrole, state, Guide counts (outside the Trash) and last login. {"parentUuid":"0e2a0e11-9a27-48c0-813c-f4ffc52e4377","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8saQq5g5YMQNJttR4ht","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017Qp4G7d2uWHsZfWLxp2bx5","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"C=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3/scratchpad/t07-review.md\ncat > $C <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T07, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review covered the uncommitted T07 work: Game Terms and nicknames, the `[[term]]` renderer, preview warnings, CSV import and the demo seed.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | The preview warns about a nickname in a **title** and suggests writing `[[瓦妮莎]]`, but titles are plain text and never rendered, so that marker would be published with its brackets. | **Fixed.** Titles get their own warnings (`rendering.title_warnings`). A nickname in a title says \"标题里请直接写 瓦妮莎\", and a marker in a title is flagged as \"会原样显示\". Test: `test_a_title_is_plain_text_so_the_preview_asks_for_the_official_name`. |\n| 2 | A malformed CSV (e.g. an unclosed quote running into an overlong cell) raised `csv.Error`, which nothing caught: a 500. | **Fixed.** `_csv_rows` turns `csv.Error` into a refusal naming the line, shown on the import page (400). Test: `test_a_csv_file_that_is_not_a_valid_csv_is_refused_whole`. |\n| 3 | Review-note quotes are matched against rendered text, which now depends on the Game Terms, so a quote can stop highlighting after a term is renamed. | **Not changed.** The preview already lists every quote it no longer finds (\"已不在正文中的\"), so the Author still sees it. The local database has no Review notes quoting `[[…]]` text from before T07. |\n| 4 | Re-running the seed called the full import, which would overwrite names an Admin had since edited. That contradicted the docstring. | **Fixed.** The seed imports with `only_new=True`, so it only adds terms that don't exist yet. Vanessa's demo nickname moved to `DEMO_HEROES`. Test: `test_seeding_again_leaves_game_terms_an_admin_has_edited`. |\n| 5 | `edit_term` crashed on a missing id, and `edit_hero` lost its old `kind = 'hero'` guard, so it could rename any term. | **Fixed.** Both refuse with a reason: `edit_term` when the id is missing, `edit_hero` when the term is not a Hero. The routes already 404 before reaching them. |\n| 6 | Chinese nicknames match anywhere, so a one-character nickname would flag ordinary text. | **Not changed.** Chinese has no word boundaries to match on, Admins choose the nicknames, and warnings never block Submit. Latin nicknames already match whole words only (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`). |\n| 7 | `preview_term_import` was `async def` but made blocking SQLite calls on the event loop. | **Fixed.** It is a plain `def` (run in the thread pool) and reads `file.file`. |\n| 8 | Nickname matching runs one regex per nickname per render. | **Not changed.** Admins record few nicknames, and a Site build renders tens of Guides, so this is cheap. A combined pattern would also need care with overlapping nicknames. |\n| 9 | The nickname storage format was written out in three places. | **Fixed.** One `_to_store` helper. |\n| 10 | `add_hero` and `add_term` repeat the insert-then-reselect pattern, and the import chooses between them with `partial`. | **Not changed.** Heroes differ in their slug and their clash rules, and the two functions are short. |\n\n## Decisions not spelled out in the ticket\n\nAsked and answered this session:\n- **CSV format:** a header row `kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames` (the nicknames column may be left out). `kind` may be written in English (`item`) or Chinese (`物品`). Several nicknames in one cell are separated by `、` or `|`. The file must be UTF-8, with or without Excel's BOM.\n- **A marker naming several Game Terms** that give different names in the target language gets a preview warning. The site shows the first match, in kind order (Hero, Item, Skill, Enchantment, Monster, Merchant, Event).\n- **A marker naming no Game Term** shows its text without the brackets on the site, unstyled.\n- **Nickname warnings** cover both languages' titles and bodies, as Readers see the text. Code and marked terms are skipped.\n\nMade while building:\n- **Where terms are managed:** Heroes stay on the 英雄 page, which gains nicknames. The new 游戏术语 page handles the other six kinds. The CSV import covers all seven.\n- **No two terms of one kind share an English Official name** (ignoring case), generalising the Hero rule. Different kinds may share names. That is why the ambiguity warning exists.\n- **CSV matching:** a row whose kind and English Official name match an existing term changes it; any other row adds a term. An **empty nicknames cell keeps** the term's nicknames, so a CSV without nicknames never wipes nicknames typed by hand.\n- **CSV rows are numbered as a spreadsheet shows them** (the header is row 1). Wholly blank rows are skipped. A repeat of an earlier row in the same file is rejected, and so is a new Hero whose slug is taken.\n- **The import preview is stateless.** The uploaded file travels back base64-encoded in the confirm form and is checked again when confirmed.\n- **Markers render inside link text and image alt text,** and stay literal inside code. A marker's name is HTML-escaped, then nh3 sanitizes the result, keeping only `class=\"term\"` on `<span>`.\n- **Schema:** `game_terms.nicknames` was added the additive way (`ADDED_COLUMNS`), one nickname per line.\n- **Demo data:** `scripts/demo_game_terms.csv` doubles as a sample import file. **Its Item names (船锚/Anchor, 火药桶/Powder Keg, 弯刀/Cutlass) have not been checked against the game's Chinese client.**\n\nVerification: `uv run pytest -q` gives 323 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors. The new console pages, the preview and both site Guide pages were checked with `/browse` at 1280px and 390px: `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 8 --body-file $C"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2800,"cache_read_input_tokens":245156,"output_tokens":2489,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":190},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2800,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2489,"cache_read_input_tokens":245156,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2800,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2800},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_017Qp4G7d2uWHsZfWLxp2bx5":{"command":"C=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3/scratchpad/t07-review.md\ncat > $C <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T07, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review covered the uncommitted T07 work: Game Terms and nicknames, the `[[term]]` renderer, preview warnings, CSV import and the demo seed.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | The preview warns about a nickname in a **title** and suggests writing `[[瓦妮莎]]`, but titles are plain text and never rendered, so that marker would be published with its brackets. | **Fixed.** Titles get their own warnings (`rendering.title_warnings`). docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md\n?? docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_15_nick-chen_20261017.md\n## Summary\n\nAdmins manage every account from the Users page (用户), and Editors are refused on every route behind it.\n\n```diff\n active ──ban──▶ Submission ban (禁止投稿) ──lift──▶ active        (Editors only)\n+  can log in and edit Drafts; Submit and opening a Revision refused, with the reason on every console page\n+active / banned ──deactivate (confirmed)──▶ Deactivated (已停用) ──reactivate──▶ active\n+  sessions end at once; login refused \"账号已停用\"; Published Guides stay in the Site build\n+any ──reset password──▶ temporary password + first-login setup again (old password and sessions gone)\n+new account (email, role, temporary password) ──first login──▶ first-login setup\n+role Editor ⇄ Admin, effective on the user's next request\n+guards: no demoting / deactivating / resetting yourself; the last active Admin is kept by the UPDATE itself\n```\n\n```text\napp/\n├── accounts.py      # manage_users; users, account, create_account, change_role, ban_submissions,\n│                    # lift_submission_ban, deactivate, reactivate, reset_password; last_login_at on log_in\n├── guides.py        # counts_by_author (Trash excluded); the ban also blocks open_revision\n├── web.py           # requires(capability) builds every Admin-only guard; 403 is a console page\n├── db.py            # users.last_login_at via ADDED_COLUMNS\n└── routes/users.py  # /admin/users, /admin/users/{id}, …/{role,ban,unban,deactivate,reactivate,password}\ntemplates/admin/\n├── users.html       # list (scrolls sideways on phones) + 添加账号 form\n├── user.html        # one account: role, ban, reset password, deactivate\n└── refused.html     # 没有权限 page, with the console navigation\n```\n\n- **Atomic checks:** each state change repeats its precondition in its UPDATE. A change another Admin makes in between, such as a Deactivation, is never overwritten, and two Admins can't remove each other at once.\n- **Banned Editors:** see the ban notice on every console page before pressing Submit or 修订 (story 76).\n- **Guards:** `trash_manager`, `site_builder`, `admin_user` and `user_manager` all come from `web.requires`. That is what lets the access test find every guarded route.\n\nReview findings and decisions: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/10#issuecomment-6244062410\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `GET /admin/users` gives 404. Account states could only be set in the database. An Editor refused on an Admin page got a plain-text 403 with no way back.\n  **After:** `tests/test_t09_users.py` has 30 tests, 65 with parametrized cases (Seam 1 for the console over HTTP, Seam 2 for `render_site`). There is also a link check of every new page in `tests/test_console_links.py`. `uv run pytest -q` gives 263 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors.\n\n```text\nUsers page                          → Display name, email, role, state, \"已发布 1 · 共 2\" (Trash excluded), last login\nAdmin creates writer@ (temp pw)     → login → /admin/setup until setup done; bad email/role/short pw/dup email → 400\nrole Editor → Admin → Editor        → editor's next GET /admin/heroes: 403 → 200 → 403\nAdmin demotes / deactivates self    → 400 with reason (no confirmation page offered either)\nban                                 → editor still logs in and saves Drafts; notice on every page;\n                                      Submit 403 \"禁止投稿\", 修订 403 and no Revision\nlift ban                            → Submit 303, status 待审核\nban an Admin / promote banned Editor → 400\ndeactivate (confirmed)              → open session → /login; login 403 \"账号已停用\"; reactivate → login works\ntwo Admins: A deactivates B         → B's stale form to deactivate A → /login, A still 正常\nstale Admin removes the last Admin  → accounts.Refused \"至少要保留一位\" (deactivate and demote)\nreset password                      → session ends; old pw 401; temp pw → setup, Display name offered\nban / deactivate + render_site      → Guide page and Author page still there\nEditor on all 21 Admin-only routes  → 403 console page with 退出登录; no change made\nsigned-out on all 21                → 303 /login\ndatabase from before T09            → last_login_at added on connect (test fails without the ADDED_COLUMNS line)\n```\n\n## Merge Danger","is_error":false}]}}

docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md\n?? docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_15_nick-chen_20261017.md\n## Summary\n\nAdmins manage every account from the Users page (用户), and Editors are refused on every route behind it.\n\n```diff\n active ──ban──▶ Submission ban (禁止投稿) ──lift──▶ active        (Editors only)\n+  can log in and edit Drafts; Submit and opening a Revision refused, with the reason on every console page\n+active / banned ──deactivate (confirmed)──▶ Deactivated (已停用) ──reactivate──▶ active\n+  sessions end at once; login refused \"账号已停用\"; Published Guides stay in the Site build\n+any ──reset password──▶ temporary password + first-login setup again (old password and sessions gone)\n+new account (email, role, temporary password) ──first login──▶ first-login setup\n+role Editor ⇄ Admin, effective on the user's next request\n+guards: no demoting / deactivating / resetting yourself; the last active Admin is kept by the UPDATE itself\n```\n\n```text\napp/\n├── accounts.py      # manage_users; users, account, create_account, change_role, ban_submissions,\n│                    # lift_submission_ban, deactivate, reactivate, reset_password; last_login_at on log_in\n├── guides.py        # counts_by_author (Trash excluded); the ban also blocks open_revision\n├── web.py           # requires(capability) builds every Admin-only guard; 403 is a console page\n├── db.py            # users.last_login_at via ADDED_COLUMNS\n└── routes/users.py  # /admin/users, /admin/users/{id}, …/{role,ban,unban,deactivate,reactivate,password}\ntemplates/admin/\n├── users.html       # list (scrolls sideways on phones) + 添加账号 form\n├── user.html        # one account: role, ban, reset password, deactivate\n└── refused.html     # 没有权限 page, with the console navigation\n```\n\n- **Atomic checks:** each state change repeats its precondition in its UPDATE. A change another Admin makes in between, such as a Deactivation, is never overwritten, and two Admins can't remove each other at once.\n- **Banned Editors:** see the ban notice on every console page before pressing Submit or 修订 (story 76).\n- **Guards:** `trash_manager`, `site_builder`, `admin_user` and `user_manager` all come from `web.requires`. {"parentUuid":"171f77ca-cae2-480a-8fdc-ce14c13836c3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8txntc4kjqKoEEZk3Cf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SuiAYUC3FqvVEAzR84sxLv","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3/scratchpad/pr-body.md\ncat > $P <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\nEvery Game Term in a Guide shows as its Official name in the Reader's language. Admins manage terms of all seven kinds, by hand or from a CSV file.\n\n```diff\n render_markdown(text, lang, glossary)          # one pass: editor preview, review page, Site build\n   markdown-it\n+    [[瓦妮莎]] / [[Vanessa]] → <span class=\"term\">Official name in lang</span>\n+    names no term → its text, no brackets            (warning)\n+    names several terms with different names → first, in kind order   (warning)\n   nh3 (keeps only class=\"term\" on <span>)\n+  unmarked nicknames in the text Readers see, code and markers skipped → one warning each, with a count\n+preview 游戏术语检查: titles and bodies, both languages; warnings never block Submit\n```\n\n```text\napp/\n├── game.py           # KINDS, Term, nicknames, add/edit_term, Glossary (lookup + nicknames_in),\n│                     # nickname_notices, CSV: plan_import, import_terms\n├── rendering.py      # [[term]] inline rule, Rendered(html, warnings), title_warnings\n├── publish.py        # Site build renders markers per tree (zh/, en/)\n├── db.py             # game_terms.nicknames via ADDED_COLUMNS\n└── routes/game.py    # /admin/terms, /admin/terms/{id}, /admin/terms/import(/confirm); Hero nicknames\ntemplates/admin/\n├── terms.html, term_edit.html                # 游戏术语: the six kinds besides Hero\n├── term_import.html, term_import_preview.html  # upload → add / change / reject by row → 确认导入\n└── guide_preview.html                        # 游戏术语检查 section\nscripts/demo_game_terms.csv                   # seed data, and a sample import file\n```\n\n- **Where terms live:** Heroes stay on the 英雄 page, which gains nicknames. The other six kinds are on 游戏术语. The CSV import covers all seven.\n- **CSV:** `kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames`. A row whose kind and English Official name match an existing term changes it; any other row adds one. An empty nicknames cell keeps the term's nicknames. Nothing is saved before 确认导入.\n- **One-character Chinese nicknames** are allowed. A notice says they match that character anywhere (finding 6, revisited).\n- **Guards:** every term and CSV route is behind `requires(\"manage_game\")`, so the router walk covers them.\n\nReview findings and decisions: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/8#issuecomment-6244483576\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `[[瓦妮莎]]` is published literally, brackets included. `GET /admin/terms` gives 404. The preview has no warnings.\n  **After:** `tests/test_t07_game_terms.py` has 34 tests, 49 with parametrized cases (Seam 1 for the console over HTTP, Seam 2 for `render_site`). There is also a link check of every new page in `tests/test_console_links.py`. `uv run pytest -q` gives 327 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors. Every new console page, the preview and both site Guide pages measure `scrollWidth` 390 at 390px (`/browse`).\n\n```text\nzh text \"[[Vanessa]] 先拿 [[pirate scimitar]]\"  → zh site: <span class=\"term\">瓦妮莎</span> … <span class=\"term\">海盗弯刀</span>\nen text \"Play [[瓦妮莎]] with [[海盗弯刀]]\"       → en site: Play <span class=\"term\">Vanessa</span> with … Pirate Scimitar\neditor preview                               → same spans; \"没有需要注意的游戏术语\"\n[[瓦姐]]                                       → warning names it; site shows 瓦姐 without brackets\n瓦姐 ×3 unmarked, `瓦姐` in code             → one warning \"（3 处）\", code not counted; Van ≠ Vanguard\n[[Pirate Scimitar]] = Item and Monster       → warning lists both; site shows the Item's name\ntitle \"瓦姐和[[Vanessa]]\"                     → \"标题里请直接写 瓦妮莎\" and \"会原样显示\"\nguide with warnings → 提交审核                → 303, 待审核\nterm named <script>… / <img onerror…>        → escaped in preview and both trees\nadd term missing a name / unknown kind / taken English name → 400 with reason, nothing saved\nCSV preview                                  → 将新增 / 将修改 (old → new) / 被拒绝 第 N 行 + reason; nothing saved\nCSV confirm                                  → \"已导入游戏术语：新增 2 个，修改 0 个。4 行被拒绝，没有导入。\"\nCSV not UTF-8 / no header / broken quoting   → 400, no 确认导入; Excel BOM read fine\nnickname 锚                                  → saved, with notice on the list, edit page and import preview\nEditor on all 7 term/CSV routes              → 403 console page\nseed twice / after an Admin edit             → demo terms added once; edited names left alone\n```\n\n## Merge Danger\n\n**Door:** two-way\n\nThe only schema change is an added column (`game_terms.nicknames`, default empty), which older code ignores. The real `cms.db` in the main checkout gets it on its next connect.\n\n**Blast Radius:** site-wide\n\n- Every Guide body on the site and in the console now goes through the marker pass. Text already written as `[[…]]` in an existing Guide changes at the next Site build: it shows the Official name, or its text without brackets.\n- nh3 now keeps `class=\"term\"` on `<span>` in Guide HTML (and only that class).\n- The console navigation gains 游戏术语. The Hero list gains a 外号 column.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\nEOF\ngit push -q origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -2; gh pr create --base main --head Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 --title \"T07: Game Terms with Official names in every Guide\" --body-file $P"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":407,"cache_read_input_tokens":269994,"output_tokens":2346,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":100},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":407,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2346,"cache_read_input_tokens":269994,"cache_creation_input_tokens":407,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":407},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01SuiAYUC3FqvVEAzR84sxLv":{"command":"P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8a7a6b96-2f6f-456a-a6ef-86009767f6f3/scratchpad/pr-body.md\ncat > $P <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\nEvery Game Term in a Guide shows as its Official name in the Reader's language. The PR body has the render pipeline, file map, test evidence and merge danger.\n- The `/code-review` findings, how each was resolved, the decisions the ticket left open, and the note on\n  revisiting finding 6 (one-character Chinese nicknames) are in\n  https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/8#issuecomment-6244483576\n- **#25 was extended this session.** It now also asks for the Guide list (`templates/admin/guides.html`) and the\n  Trash (`templates/admin/trash.html`) tables to go in `<div class=\"scroll\">`. Nothing for #25 is implemented yet.\n- At handoff, 327 tests passed and pyright reported 0 errors. The branch was pushed and its commits are in `main`.\n- **Not committed yet:** `notes/usage-ledger.csv`, `docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md`, transcript 15\n  (`docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_15_nick-chen_20261017.md`) and this file. They go into the next\n  \"Add transcript NN\" commit, with transcript 16 and the ledger rows (see the credential-scan convention below).\n- `.claude/state/phase` still says `T07`. Update it when the next stage starts.\n\n## Next tickets (open issues; ask the user which one to take)\n\n- **#9 T08: Pages and Tournament items appear in the public navigation.** The last core ticket.\n- **#25: Show console and site times in Beijing time, plus scrolling tables for the Guide list and the Trash.**\n  No labels on purpose, because the change touches many places. The issue lists every place a time is shown. Times\n  stay stored in UTC.\n- #11 S1 images (stretch) · #12 S2 hosted console (stretch, last; ADR-003 supersedes ADR-001 then).\n\nRead the ticket, spec #1 (`gh issue view 1`), and `CONTEXT.md` before coding, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.\n\n## What the next tickets must fit around (from T07, not obvious from the spec)\n\n- **One render function:** `rendering.render_markdown(text, lang, glossary)` returns `Rendered(html, warnings)`.\n  - Every Markdown body goes through it: the preview, the review page, the Review-note quote check\n    (`guides._checked_notes`) and the Site build (`publish.environment(glossary)`, filter `markdown(lang)`).\n  - Get the glossary with `game.glossary(conn)`.\n  - **T08's Pages and Tournament items** should render their bodies the same way, so markers work there too. That\n    means the Jinja filter `|markdown(lang)` on the site and `render_markdown(..., lang, game.glossary(conn))` in\n    the console.\n  - Titles are plain text, never rendered. `rendering.title_warnings` covers them in the preview.\n- **nh3 keeps only `class=\"term\"` on `<span>`** (`allowed_classes`). A new class in sanitized HTML has to be added\n  there.\n- **Markers in markdown-it:** the inline rule `_game_term` returns False in silent mode on purpose, so a marker\n  inside a link label doesn't cancel the link. `_Renderer.renderInlineAsText` puts the term's name into image alt\n  text.\n- **Game Terms:**\n  - Heroes are managed on `/admin/heroes`, the other six kinds on `/admin/terms`, and CSV import is at\n    `/admin/terms/import`.\n  - No two terms of one kind share an English Official name (ignoring case). Different kinds may.\n  - Nicknames are stored one per line in `game_terms.nicknames` (added via `ADDED_COLUMNS`). Write them through\n    `game._to_store`.\n  - `game.nickname_notices` flags one-character Chinese nicknames. Routes flash these with the new flash kind\n    `notice` (`.flash-notice` in `base.html`).\n- **Route order in `app/routes/game.py`:** `POST /admin/terms/import` must stay declared before\n  `POST /admin/terms/{term_id}`, which would otherwise catch it (there is a comment).\n- **Seed:** `scripts/seed_demo.py` imports `scripts/demo_game_terms.csv` with `only_new=True`, so re-seeding never\n  overwrites an Admin's edits. The user checked the demo Item names on bazaardb.gg. T08 adds the demo Page and\n  Tournament items, as the seed docstring says.\n- **Wide console tables:**\n  - Wrap them in `<div class=\"scroll\">`.\n  - A cell holding a sentence can take `class=\"wrap\"`, which lets it wrap inside the scrolling table, as the CSV\n    rejection reasons do.\n\n## Working conventions\n\nEverything in the \"Working conventions\" sections of `docs/handoff/01_t05-to-t06_20261017.md`,\n`02_t06-to-next_20261017.md` and `03_t09-to-next_20261017.md` still holds:\n- the typecheck and test commands,\n- the review comment before the closing commit,\n- the commit and PR style,\n- transcript commits and the credential scan,\n- `/browse` for visual checks,\n- adding each new console page to `tests/test_console_links.py`,\n- checking `scrollWidth` at 390px.\n\nAdditions this session:\n- **`/implement` is not loaded as a skill** in these sessions (`mattpocock-skills:implement` is missing from the\n  skill list). When the user types `/implement #N`, read\n  `~/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/implement/SKILL.md`\n  and follow it: state the ticket's title, TDD at Seams 1 and 2, typecheck often, `/code-review`, commit.\n- **Ask about product choices before coding.** At the start of T07 the user answered four choices in one\n  AskUserQuestion: CSV format, ambiguous markers, unknown markers, nickname scope. The answers are in the #8\n  comment.\n- **T07 test helpers** in `tests/test_t07_game_terms.py`:\n  - `add_term`, `term_edit_link`, `edit_term`, `preview_of`, `upload_csv`, `confirm_import`;\n  - the constant `CSV_HEADER`.\n  - It reuses `published_guide`, `page` and `site` from `test_t04_site_build.py`.\n- **`/code-review` only sees tracked changes.** Run `git add -N` on new files first, or the review misses them.\n- **Credential scan false positive:** `ghp_import` in `app/publish.py` matches a `ghp_` token pattern. It is the\n  module name, not a token.\n- **`/browse` pages:** the scratch script that saved T07's pages lived in the session scratchpad, which is gone.\n  Recreate it the way handoff 03 describes, then copy the HTML into `.gstack/` (git-ignored).\n- **PR merges** use `gh pr merge N --merge` (a merge commit, like #24 and #26). Never `--delete-branch`.\n- **There are no CI checks** on this repo. \"Mergeable\" means no conflicts. Run the suite locally before merging.\n\n## Suggested skills\n\n- `mattpocock-skills:tdd`: red→green per slice at Seam 1 (console over HTTP) and Seam 2 (`render_site`). Confirm\n  any seam beyond those with the user first.\n- `code-review` (built-in, runs in the background): post its findings, and how each was resolved, on the issue\n  before the closing commit.\n- `mattpocock-skills:pr`: the PR body template used for #22 to #24 and #26.\n- `browse`: visual check of new console or site pages at 1280 and 390 px (never the `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`\n  tools, per the user's global `CLAUDE.md`).\n- `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling`: T08 brings Page and Tournament states (and #25 may bring a display-time\n  rule), to record in `CONTEXT.md`.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":609,"cache_read_input_tokens":274999,"output_tokens":3106,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":609,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3106,"cache_read_input_tokens":274999,"cache_creation_input_tokens":609,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":609},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01DxrLeu8yHqDwjnjbPHXZWF":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/docs/handoff/04_t07-to-next_20261017.md","content":"# Handoff: 大巴扎攻略站 CMS, after T07\n\nRepo: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2` (a git worktree on branch\n`Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`, reused for every ticket; Different kinds may.\n  - Nicknames are stored one per line in `game_terms.nicknames` (added via `ADDED_COLUMNS`). Routes flash these with the new flash kind\n    `notice` (`.flash-notice` in `base.html`).\n- **Route order in `app/routes/game.py`:** `POST /admin/terms/import` must stay declared before\n  `POST /admin/terms/{term_id}`, which would otherwise catch it (there is a comment).\n- **Seed:** `scripts/seed_demo.py` imports `scripts/demo_game_terms.csv` with `only_new=True`, so re-seeding never\n  overwrites an Admin's edits.
